name: user-hud
description: A control panel tucked into the corner above the Claude Code prompt, as cards in seven modules you turn on or off: your other sessions (which need you, which are working), a context battery and where your tokens go (files, chat, MCP, shell, skills and plugins, subagents and more), model and effort pickers in three styles, prompt-cache countdown with a 2-minute keep-warm alert, the guesses Claude acts on for you to mark right or wrong, handoff buttons, and next steps (follow-up prompts after each reply, one key to put in the prompt box).

cacheModule.title: Module: cache
cacheModule.description: The prompt cache countdown, Keep warm, the expiry alerts and the overage warning, with /cache and /keepwarm. Off, none of it runs.

pickersModule.title: Module: pickers
pickersModule.description: The model and effort pickers, with /hud-styles.

tokensModule.title: Module: tokens
tokensModule.description: How full the context is and where the session's tokens go: the context battery, the CONTEXT card, the Tokens pane and /tokens. Off, nothing is counted.

handoffModule.title: Module: handoff
handoffModule.description: Write handoff and Read handoff, with /read-handoff.

nextModule.title: Module: next steps
nextModule.description: After each reply, up to three follow-up prompts in the panel; 1, 2 or 3 puts one in the prompt box to edit or send. Each reply costs one short Haiku call on the last prompt and reply, not the whole conversation.

sessionsModule.title: Module: sessions
sessionsModule.description: Your other sessions on this machine: which need you, which are working, which finished lately. The SESSIONS card, the counts on the closed row and the Sessions pane, read from ~/.claude/sessions every 5 seconds. Off, nothing is read.

assumeModule.title: Module: guesses
assumeModule.description: An assumption tool Claude calls with the guesses it acts on, and the CHECK MY GUESSES card where you mark each right or wrong. Off, the tool is not registered.

warnSeconds.title: Alert when this many seconds are left
warnSeconds.description: Seconds of cache life left when the keep-warm alert fires.

notifyMac.title: macOS alert
notifyMac.description: Also show a macOS alert when the cache is about to expire, with a Keep warm button, so you see it from another app. It closes by itself after the seconds below.

alertSeconds.title: macOS alert stays (seconds)
alertSeconds.description: How long the macOS alert stays on screen before it closes by itself.

sound.title: Alert sound
sound.description: Play the Glass system sound (macOS afplay) when the alert fires.

autoKeepWarm.title: Keep the cache warm automatically
autoKeepWarm.description: Send a tiny keep-warm ping by itself 30 seconds before expiry, up to the limit below per idle stretch. Each ping is billed as a cache read.

maxAutoPings.title: Automatic pings per idle stretch
maxAutoPings.description: The most automatic pings between two of your prompts.

showBand.title: Show the corner panel above the prompt
showBand.description: The user-hud tab and its panel of cards (sessions, context, model and effort, cache, guesses, next steps, handoff, settings) above the prompt.

handoffPath.title: Handoff note location
handoffPath.description: A file or folder (relative to the project) where your /handoff writes. Empty searches HANDOFF.md, .claude/, .claude/handoffs/, handoffs/ and docs/ for markdown files named like a handoff.

selectorStyle.title: Picker style
selectorStyle.description: How the model and effort pickers are drawn: Rail (labels over a segmented bar, the chosen segment solid), Ladder (one row, a strip before each label that grows with the step) or Meter (bars that rise step by step, lit up to the chosen one).
